_doc: Tiruppur's 18 common effluent treatment plants (CETPs) for textile bleaching and dyeing units, as listed by TNPCB (2020) and by the state's June 2026 progress report to NMCG, all operating. No proposed CETP scheme for Tiruppur is on the Department of Textiles' 'Nadanthai Vaazhi Cauvery' page (checked 2026-10-21; its ten schemes are in Erode and Namakkal districts), so 'schemes' is empty.

Location names are as printed, except that the June 2026 report's dash between name and 'Tiruppur' is written here as a hyphen. Rows are transcribed from the PDFs and each row is checked by script (scripts/cetp.py) against the page's text layer; the tables were also read from the rendered page images (img/v-tnpcb-textile2020-p1.png, -p2.png, img/v-mpr-tn-2026-06-p53.png, -p54.png).

registerUnitId joins each plant to the TNGIS industry register's unit of the same name (treatment-plants.geojson, kind cetp, 14 units). The join is by name and is the part to review: see joinBasis, especially R15TPN2078008 (Mangalam).

consentedKld repeats TNPCB's 2020 column headed 'DPR Quantity (in KLD)', to match the field the engine reads (scripts/lib/tn_district_basin.py plant_facts); consentIssuedOn is the column 'CTO issued on' and renewalValidTo the column 'RCO Validity' of 2020. The June 2026 report gives the current renewal status in mpr2026.renewalStatus.
notOnRegister: the four listed plants with no register unit (Arulpuram, Kallikadu, Tiruppur Murugampalayam, Andipalayam). No official source read prints their location, so they are not drawn.

Left out: TNPCB row 19 and the June 2026 report's row 19, Perundurai CETP (printed 'Perundurai CETP- Tiruppur' in the June 2026 report), which is in Erode district and is already in pipeline-inputs/basins/erode-rivers/cetp-schemes.json.
